Numeric HTML entities (decimal and hex) are decoded

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Copyright: &#169; Trade: &#174; Euro: &#8364; Hex: &#x00A9;</p>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
